'''Bravo 3''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|Clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bravo 3 piloted one of three [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tanks]] that composed [[Bravo Squadron (Republic)|Bravo Squadron]]. The unit was led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. They saw action during the [[Battle of Thule]].

==History==
Bravo 3 was among the forces deployed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] via an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] along with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Anakin Skywalker with the task of disabling a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary]] [[Sivvi shield generator complex|shield]] protecting Thule. Upon landing, they were promptly engaged by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces deployed from a nearby [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]] overlooking the position.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

When the area was cleared, Bravo 3 assisted Skywalker and his [[Bravo 4 (clone trooper)|squadmate]] in protecting a convoy of [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|Republic Troop Transports]] bound for the complex with their complement of [[clone engineer]]s. Along the way, the group encountered waves of [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]], [[Ground Armored Tank]]s, and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|Spider walkers]] before [[Convoy 1|one of the transports]] succumbed to artillery fire from a distance, forcing them to stop momentarily.<ref name="Clone Wars" />

After Skywalker eliminated the [[Heavy Artillery Gun]]s firing on their position with his [[All Terrain Experimental Transport|AT-XT]], the group resumed along the path, encountering additional droid craft. After eliminating a pair of laser turrets guarding the perimeter of the complex, as well as [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] approaching from the sides, the remaining transports successfully ferried the engineers, therefore breaching the wall and allowing Skywalker passage. Because of Bravo 3's efforts, Skywalker was successful in lowering the shield, completing the first phase of the mission.<ref name="Clone Wars" />
